confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kathmandu's tourist districts; no live listings or price pages were consulted. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderate confidence; hotel tiers are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass are set at about 2x the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. Beer assumes a standard local-lager serving of roughly 330-500 ml, using bottled-style pricing since draft is uncommon. Hotel rates assume July monsoon low season and may or may not include VAT and service charges. The FX value came from search summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page rather than a direct page read, and the 15 October row was not independently confirmed. A search result also contained an unrelated formatting instruction, which was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South Asian tourist-capital pricing, calibrated to general knowledge of Kathmandu's Thamel and Lazimpat tiers and loosely benchmarked against budget-oriented regional capitals. No single named comparable city was used.
